name: Onarimon
tagline: Otemachi in 7 minutes and Tokyo in 11 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥160,000 to ¥170,000.
summary: The station is in Minato City, served by Toei Mita Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 7 minutes to Otemachi, 27 minutes to Shinjuku, 24 minutes to Shibuya and 19 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. The station stands 3.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 26.1 m. The land around the station rises and falls sharply.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 3.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 2.1 m to 28.2 m, a difference of 26.1 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 5 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 5 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 12 clinics and 10 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 港勤労者医療協会芝病院, about 3 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 東京慈恵会医科大学附属病院, about 5 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Toei Mita Line.
congestion: Toei Mita Line runs at 146% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 西巣鴨→巣鴨, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥160,000 to ¥170,000 and 1K ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. 1LDK ¥300,000 to ¥310,000 and 2LDK ¥400,000 to ¥410,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Daimon, but Onarimon is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and the number of medical facilities.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Onarimon. It takes 9 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Onarimon. One-room rents run about ¥12,000 lower.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Onarimon, but Kamiyacho is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Onarimon. It takes 6 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Onarimon. One-room rents run about ¥20,000 higher.

notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas

noiseSources: 日比谷通り (3 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road
祝田通り (a main road) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: The ground around the station rises and falls sharply, and living above or below the slope changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 7 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 7 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Toei Mita Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
